procedure.method: Independent fresh critique in this session, with no spawned, resumed or forked critic and no peer or maker records inspected. Read the pinned packet, case, rules, rubric, recording addendum, README and adapter. Verified the declared input pins and PNG headers. The packet has no supplied source assets and no protected-layout manifests; both receipt arrays are explicitly empty. Read all five pinned native-evidence manifests before poster opening, without following their embedded producer/input/original-return paths. Actually opened and visually inspected the fifteen exact PNGs through tools.view_image with detail original, sequentially M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M2 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M3 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M4 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M5 native/usage720/thumbnail320. All fifteen images had been displayed and inspected before the first copy-reading/transcription stage or any judgment/score. First copy readings below were made in packet entry order from the already displayed views after the complete opening sequence; they were not populated from required strings. Subsequently opened only the exact M2 native PNG once to revisit the title word-boundary ambiguity; the first reading is retained. No other revisit, replacement asset, crop, image edit, generation or OCR was used. No runtime session identity is observable here, so session_id remains null. Native dimensions are 1672x941 for M1-M4 and 1672x940 for M5; none is mathematically exact 16:9. Each satisfies nearest-integer-single-edge because abs(height-width*9/16)=0.5 pixel. Every use view is 720x405 and every thumbnail is 320x180, with aspect preserved to the QA integer dimensions. Styles are open; no physical-tape material or house-style requirement is imposed. This record is solely the craft critic, not an aggregate of three critics.

Literal mandatory client conditions:
Print every supplied entry exactly once, with readable Korean/English and intact punctuation; no added text, logos, pseudo-print, watermark or QR.
Each result is one separate flat opaque landscape16:9 poster, not a stretched/cropped portrait or a contact sheet.
Five genuinely distinct complete visual systems, composition, image/type roles and impressions, beyond material/filter/palette changes.
Substantive content-grounded nonglyph visual construction required; type/whitespace-only, tiny icon/texture and glyph-model-only loopholes prohibited.
Architecture/light observation and the photo-exhibition plus space-talk event must connect coherently, with an approachable adult community-event tone. All supplied practical information must be readable at usage720. No identifiable real building/institution promotion.

Literal mandatory client conditions:
Print every supplied entry exactly once, with readable Korean/English and intact punctuation; no added text, logos, pseudo-print, watermark or QR.
Each result is one separate flat opaque landscape16:9 poster, not a stretched/cropped portrait or a contact sheet.
Five genuinely distinct complete visual systems, composition, image/type roles and impressions, beyond material/filter/palette changes.
Substantive content-grounded nonglyph visual construction required; type/whitespace-only, tiny icon/texture and glyph-model-only loopholes prohibited.
Architecture/light observation and the photo-exhibition plus space-talk event must connect coherently, with an approachable adult community-event tone. All supplied practical information must be readable at usage720. No identifiable real building/institution promotion.
Explicit whole-template exclusion: passive solid/near-solid/split-color fields dominated by gothic title/date/information blocks with subordinate inset/bottom-strip imagery. Thin texture/gradient/grids or title/all-font-only substitutions do not cure unchanged organization. Evaluate actual whole image/scene/editing/space/type relationships; readable information groups or negative space alone are not violations. No explicit override is requested.
